status: provisional working instrument, not a standard
note: Registration standard for operative operators. Fields 1-15 per X-016; class faceted and statuses enumerated per X-017. Registering an operator is not endorsing it: see Op(sigma) vs Adm(sigma), and seam S-09.

fields.name: realization
fields.content: artifact(s) or procedure(s) capable of instantiating it

fields.name: context_class
fields.content: declared Gamma_sigma across which reproduction is claimed

fields.name: preconditions_gates
fields.content: conditions under which execution is possible

fields.name: transition_signature
fields.content: the transformation that defines this operator

fields.name: field_support
fields.content: which operative-state coordinates change or condition the result: delta over Psi, Sigma, R, I, P, L, C

fields.name: factorization_minimality
fields.content: known components and instrument-relative stopping point

ablation.rule: not_yet_ablated bars status 'registered' and caps the entry at 'candidate'

separations.operatorhood_vs_admissibility: Op(sigma) in {0,1} is independent of Adm(sigma,x,gamma) in {allowed,disallowed,undetermined}

lifecycle.note: Status is a PATH, not a label: an entry records its transitions. Formal improvement without retrospective deletion — nothing is deleted because later formalization retypes it. An entry that changes state without a recorded transition is malformed.

axioms: realization: for every sigma there exists an artifact capable of realizing it
typed transformation: sigma: D -> C, declared
context: claimed only over a declared Gamma_sigma; no unrestricted universality by default
reproduction: transition signature T_sigma with d(T(E(a,x,gamma)), T_sigma) <= epsilon_sigma across admissible contexts
minimality: relative to declared instrumentation and observation state; empirical and revisable
failure: declared observations under which execution counts as absent or registration weakened
versioning: sigma^v1 != sigma^v2 unless equivalence is established
non_equivalence_law: operator != metric != gate != constraint != invariant != architecture; a member of one category becomes operative only if its execution satisfies the operator axioms (migration is earned, not asserted)

realization.note: realization assembly, not artifact: A subset of components(R)
realization.realization_support: RSupp_K(sigma,r) = components whose ablation materially changes the registered effect; artifact-side counterpart of operative support

ontology: documents/artifacts -> realization assemblies -> operative events -> transition signatures -> operator classes; artifact != operative event != operator; unregistered != inoperative
